name: Samir Rahman
title: Managing Partner
bio: Founder and Managing Partner. Started Rafid FS in 2011 after fifteen years in regional audit practice; still signs off on every advisory engagement personally.

name: Layla Aziz
title: Partner, Advisory
bio: Leads the advisory and audit practice. Works mostly with family-owned SMEs on growth planning and controls.

name: Nabil Hadid
title: Finance Manager
bio: Runs the internal finance function and the accounts team. Owns the month-end close and the vendor-payment run.

name: Farah Karim
title: Accounts Payable Specialist
bio: Handles the full accounts-payable cycle: vendor onboarding, invoice intake, three-way matching, and the same-day payment queue. Point of contact for all supplier billing questions.

name: Rana Saleh
title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
bio: Manages client invoicing and collections. Keeps the receivables ledger and the ageing report.

name: Hani Mansour
title: Payroll Officer
bio: Processes monthly payroll for Rafid FS and for a dozen outsourced-payroll clients.

name: Firas Otoom
title: Senior Bookkeeper
bio: Senior bookkeeper for the firm's retained clients. Trains the junior bookkeeping staff on Sage.

name: Reem Deeb
title: Bookkeeper
bio: Bookkeeper on the SME client portfolio. Handles day-to-day ledger entry and reconciliations.

name: Kamal Darwish
title: Senior Auditor
bio: Leads statutory audit fieldwork. Twelve years across manufacturing and retail clients.

name: Mona Fahmy
title: Audit Associate
bio: Audit associate on the mid-market team. Newly qualified; focused on testing and working papers.

name: Tarek Younis
title: Advisory Consultant
bio: Advisory consultant on financial modelling and internal-controls reviews for growing clients.

name: Sana Khalil
title: Tax Manager
bio: Heads the tax practice: corporate filings, VAT, and cross-border advisory for the firm's SME clients.

name: Adel Barakat
title: Tax Associate
bio: Prepares corporate and VAT returns. Manages the filing calendar for the tax team.

name: Waleed Haddad
title: IT Administrator
bio: Sole IT administrator. Runs the firm's Outlook 365 tenant, the Sage 50 install, endpoints, and remote access. Handles onboarding and account setup.

name: Dina Said
title: IT Support Technician
bio: First-line IT support for the office. Password resets, printer wrangling, new-starter setup.

name: Nadia Fawzi
title: HR Manager
bio: Owns recruitment, onboarding, and staff development across the firm.

name: Omar Rashid
title: HR Coordinator
bio: Coordinates hiring logistics and the new-starter checklist. Posts the firm's job openings.

name: Bassel Hakim
title: Operations Manager
bio: Runs office operations, procurement, and the facilities team.

name: Yusuf Karim
title: Facilities Coordinator
bio: Coordinates building maintenance, deliveries, and office supplies. No relation to Farah in Finance — a coincidence the switchboard is used to.

name: Jana Nasser
title: Office Administrator
bio: Front-desk and office administration. First point of contact for visitors and the main switchboard.
